tncz18n7.baseName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Slim Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
tncz18n7.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Slim Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
tncz18n7.sourceDescription: Enjoy a festive glow with the 6ft Pre-lit Slim Wildhorn Pine. This elegant 6ft pre-lit Christmas tree combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 300 multi-function warm white LED lights in a slender shape, making it a lovely choice for smaller living rooms, apartments and cosy corners. Featuring distinctive short-cut pine needle foliage, the Slim Wildhorn Pine has traditional PVC tips tucked towards the centre. These add depth and fullness, while the outer branches give a natural appearance. It offers a beautifully full look within a narrow silhouette. It has gently upswept branches and a slim, tapered shape, with natural green shades and subtle brown detailing. The warm white LED lights highlight the texture of the needles, while their multi-function settings let you choose the lighting effect to suit your festive display. The tree comes in three sections, with hinged branches for easy assembly and a supportive metal stand. Spread inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 6ft • Pre-lit: 300 multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 635 • Foliage: Realistic pine needle outer branches with traditional PVC tips towards the centre for added fullness • Foliage colour: Natural green • Tree width: 80cm diameter • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches and three tree sections • Base: Metal stand measuring 50cm in diameter • Includes gloves to wear during assembly • Indoor use only • Guarantee: 10 years on foliage and branches, plus 1 year on the lights • Supplied in one carton • Carton dimensions: 86cm × 25cm × 27cm • Weight: 8.15kg • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

b0e2ttkx.baseName: Walplus 303 Branch Tips Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
b0e2ttkx.variantName: Walplus 303 Branch Tips Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
b0e2ttkx.sourceDescription: The Modern Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree brings festive cheer to any home or outdoor space. Designed with simplicity and functionality in mind, it features a clean, minimalist aesthetic while ensuring durability and ease of use. This seasonal décor piece is ideal for adorning living rooms, gardens, and terraces, adding a touch of luxury with lifelike tips and vibrant decorative elements. Its versatile appearance makes it a fitting centerpiece during the holiday season, radiating warmth and celebration spirit. Decorative Elements: This Christmas tree comes beautifully adorned with pine corns and bright red berries that add a festive and natural touch. The thoughtfully placed decorations maintain a harmonious balance, offering a cohesive and stylish holiday theme. These elements also offer visual depth, enhancing the overall appearance whether placed indoors or in a covered outdoor area. Realistic Design: Crafted with lifelike tips, the tree mimics the natural texture of actual foliage, bringing authenticity to its appearance. The detailed design not only makes this tree a focal point of holiday décor but also creates an inviting atmosphere that resembles a real pine, ensuring the seasonal magic comes to life in your home. Easy Setup: Equipped with hinged branches, the tree ensures a straightforward assembly process, saving valuable time and energy during the busy festive season. This intuitive design makes putting up and taking down the tree a hassle-free task, allowing you to easily enjoy the holiday cheer without unnecessary fuss or time-consuming struggles. Stable Base: The tree sits securely on a foldable metal stand, providing excellent stability and support. The durable stand assures it remains in place, preventing wobbling or sagging, thus presenting a neat and organized holiday display. Its foldable feature also allows for practical storage post-holidays, adding to ease of use and convenience. User Instructions: To achieve a fuller and more vibrant tree, users are recommended to allocate 30-45 minutes for shaping its branches. Following the included instructions aids in achieving optimal aesthetics. Additionally, assembling requires two individuals and a screwdriver, accommodating a collaborative holiday setup experience. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC, pe and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 68 cm Stand size: 35 x 35 cm Decorated with pine corns and red berries Lifelike Tips FoldableStand Hinged Branches for Easy Setup Snow Flocked Number of PE tips: 77 Number of PVC tips: 303 Number of needle tips: 76 Number of pine cones: 40 Number of red berries: 40 Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial hinged Christmas tree 1 x Foldable metal stand • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
